questions.question: What should I do about .env.stage's MAIL_FROM?

options.label: Change to yourfamilyfund.com (match dev)
options.description: Keep the same MAIL_FROM across all envs for consistency. Affects real outbound stage mail headers, but the change is local-only (.env.stage is gitignored).

options.label: Leave .env.stage alone
options.description: Honor the brief's 'dev only' boundary. Stage may have its own SOPS-managed value that the next stage-side sync overwrites anyway.

options.label: Leave alone — trust prod-to-dev.sh
options.description: The 2.3 MB raw prod dump is the documented seed input. Now that prod_to_dev.sql is fixed, the scrub will fully clean the DB on next refresh. Don't string-replace the file.

options.label: Delete it from disk
options.description: Remove the on-disk copy entirely. You can re-pull from your backup host (per SETUP.md L37) when you actually need to refresh dev. Removes the lingering raw-PII artifact.

options.label: Also string-replace inside it
options.description: Replace familyfund.com with yourfamilyfund.com in the dump. WARNING: this masks only the emails — real first/last names (27+ rows: Togni / Geremia / Bavaresco / ...) remain. Likely a false-confidence fix.

transcript_tail.text: What is the current email that still shows

`no-reply@familyfund.com` — the system MAIL_FROM address, not a person's email.

**Where it comes from:** `app1/family-fund-app/.env` line 50:
```
MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS=no-reply@familyfund.com
```
(Also same value in `.env.dev` line 50.)

**Where it renders:** /emails → "Email Configuration" card → "From address" row. Pulled via `config('mail.from.address')` in `EmailController::getEmailConfig()` (app/Http/Controllers/WebV1/EmailController.php:182).

**Why it triggered the audit:** the family-emails-list intentionally has a broad `^.*@familyfund\.com.*$` pattern (since the family owns that domain). So *any* `@familyfund.com` address — including the system `no-reply@` — matches, even though no real person is exposed.

**To fix purely for clean demo videos:** change to `no-reply@dev.familyfund.local` in `app1/family-fund-app/.env` (and `.env.dev` to survive an `.env.dev → .env` symlink rebuild). No DB or code change, no restart needed for new mail (Laravel reads it per-request via `config()`); the /emails Configuration card will render the new value on next refresh. Want me to do that?
The family fund is not a real domain, so we can use it for now. Actually, we should, uh, maybe put your family fund instead, so... or something more generic.

Done. /emails now renders `no-reply@yourfamilyfund.com` and matches `0` against the family-emails-list. The full dev surface (`/accounts`, `/people`, `/persons`, `/users`, `/emails`) is now at 0 family-list matches.

Change is in `app1/family-fund-app/.env.dev:50` (and `.env` follows via symlink). `.env*` is gitignored — local-only, no commit needed.
What are all the scripts that anonymize what use FamilyFund dot com? Can you search in the codebase and replace by your family fund?

Here's what I found. There are no anonymization *scripts* that use `familyfund.com` — the actual scrub code uses `@dev.familyfund.local` for synthetic addresses, and the only `familyfund.local` references in code are the dstrader service-user (unrelated, different domain).

The full `familyfund.com` surface in the codebase (including gitignored files):

| File | Line | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `app1/family-fund-app/.env.dev` | 50 | ✅ already changed to `yourfamilyfund.com` |
| `app1/family-fund-app/.env.stage` | 47 | ⚠️ stage env — not changed (brief: "dev only") |
| `database/dev/familyfund_dev_data_20260419.sql` | 8 person rows | ⚠️ raw PII data dump — should NOT be string-replaced |
| `app1/family-fund-app/.env.example` | 55 | already `hello@example.com` (clean) |
| `docs/INTEGRATIONS.md`, `docs/runbooks/ff-service-token-rotation.md`, `app1/family-fund-app/config/familyfund.php` | service user | `familyfund.local`, not `.com` — unrelated |

**Two are real decisions, not blind replaces:**

1. **`.env.stage:47`** — also uses `no-reply@familyfund.com`. If you want stage's MAIL_FROM to match dev, I can change it; but the brief said dev-only and stage MAIL_FROM affects real outbound stage mail headers, so I held off.

2. **`database/dev/familyfund_dev_data_20260419.sql`** — this is the 2.3 MB *raw prod data dump* used to seed dev (per SETUP.md:37). It contains real first/last names (Laura, Togni, etc.) alongside the 27 family-email matches. The correct flow is: load this file → run `prod_to_dev.sql` to scrub. **Doing a string-replace inside this file would only mask emails while leaving the real names intact, giving false confidence.** The right fix is the one already shipped (f5144a9e) — prod-to-dev.sh now fully scrubs the DB after loading, including the latent password_resets abort that was the root cause. Better options for this file: (a) leave alone and trust the now-working scrub, (b) delete it and re-pull from backup only when needed, or (c) replace it with a synthetic seed.
